name: Penarrow Junction Signal Box
kind: mechanical railway signal box lever frame
design: polished-oak fascia over a cast-iron six-lever interlocking frame, cream enamel legend plates and brass roundels, a black-steel mimic diagram with incandescent track-circuit jewels, daylight lit with no glow at all
interaction: six levers pulled against a self-locking interlock in bell-offered sequence, with a single block-bell plunger to accept trains and obtain line clear
tagline: Six levers, one bell, and four minutes between trains.

name: Halberd Fire Director Mk. IV
design: olive-grey hammer-finish enamel over riveted steel, stencilled white capitals and engraved brass data plates, incandescent jewel lamps on a daylight panel, ivory counter drums and a nickelled tracking bench
interaction: twin spoked handwheels that hold an optical reticle on a moving ship until the amber match lamp burns steady, then a brass fire key under a red collar and an overheat interlock
tagline: Keep the cross on her funnel and the drums will do the arithmetic.

name: Verity Anaesthetic Apparatus Mk. II
design: polished-nickel trolley with white vitreous legend plates, black bakelite knobs and knurled skirts, tapered-glass rotameters with steel bobbins, a leather-edged rebreathing bag, lit by daylight alone
interaction: trim two multi-turn needle valves until the floats sit on their scribe lines, set the halothane percent dial, ride the pop-off against the manometer and watch the bag breathe
tagline: Two floats on the line, one and a half percent, and the bag breathes itself.

name: Corriedhu Grid Supply Point - 132/33 kV Control Panel
kind: grid substation control and mimic panel
design: light-grey powder-coat steel with slate-blue fascia band, engraved traffolyte legends, LED indication centres, a mosaic single-line mimic with moving-iron dials, and a green-phosphor RTU screen as the only glow in the room
interaction: spring-return rotary control switches worked against a live synchroscope for the reclose, twin OLTC rockers balanced by an AUTO regulator, and an eight-window annunciator that must be accepted before it is believed
tagline: Close her on the synchroscope, not on hope.

name: Kettleby Colliery No. 2 Winder - Driver's Console
design: riveted black-iron plate with machined bright edges, safety-yellow lever handles and quadrant, engraved white-on-black traffolyte plates, incandescent wedge-lens annunciators, a drawn shaft section with friction wheel as the centrepiece, lit by caged strip light
interaction: two-hand driving: left palm on a bail brake lever pulled to release, right hand walking a notched bidirectional power quadrant, landing the cage by eye on the depth counter and rope drum
tagline: Left hand brake, right hand power, eyes on the drum.

name: Pillaton Manual Exchange - Position No. 1
design: petrol-blue crystalline-enamel steel over an oak-edged writing shelf, transfer-printed cream legends, a brass lamp-and-jack multiple worked by cloth-braided cords, tungsten ivory lamp caps in a daylight room with one amber rectifier neon
interaction: lift a cord pair's plugs from their wells, seat them front-and-rear across the twelve-line multiple and throw the pair's RING-TALK lever key against a flywheel ring generator while the ticket pad writes itself
tagline: Answer inside forty seconds, or the supervisor reads about it.

name: Coralline Cargo Control - Crude Oil Discharge Console
design: warm buff epoxy-painted steel with engraved traffolyte legends, backlit amber film cells behind quarter-turn cargo valves, etched tank sight-glasses, a printed hull-stress card with a brass pointer, incandescent jewels under daylight bridge lighting
interaction: lining up a backlit cargo valve matrix and easing three notched steam throttles against a live hull-bending curve while holding the inert oxygen under eight percent
tagline: Empty her flat and easy - the hull bends before the gauges tell you.

name: Ferriday 9/F Process Computer - Operator's Front Panel
design: warm brown crinkle-enamel chassis with brushed-aluminium trim, white silk-screened condensed capitals, frosted amber register lamps in chrome rims, four glowing orange nixie clusters, backlit annunciator lens strips, a cream-faced moving-coil meter pair and a hinged fault-injector tray, lit entirely by room light except the machine's own tubes
interaction: twelve-paddle ADDRESS and DATA banks worked with ADDRESS LOAD, EXAMINE and DEPOSIT keys against live nixie readouts, freed by a guarded START and traded against core-stack heat on a CLOCK RATE knob, single-stepped in MAINT
tagline: Set twelve bits, press DEPOSIT, and keep the core stack under sixty-five.

name: Hawthorne Grand Theatre - Dimmer Board No. 1
design: forest-green crackle-finish steel with copper dimmer arcs, engraved ivory enamel legend plates, tungsten jewel annunciators, liquid cage thermometers and a live proscenium mimic, lit by daylight from the fly-floor louvres
interaction: six cranked handles walked along resistance arcs against a full-width counterweighted grandmaster lever, dipping the whole stage by hand while watching two cage thermometers and a hot-iron ammeter
tagline: Dips on the grandmaster, never by walking the arcs.

name: Skerravy Light - Optic Driving & Fog-Signal Machinery
kind: rock lighthouse optic-drive and fog-signal machine room
design: white-enamelled cast-iron frame with engraved brass roman-cap plates and a verdigris copper hood, glazed slate tower-section mimic with falling weight and revolving lens drum, brass-bezel Bourdon dials, drop-flag annunciators, lit by daylight with only the beam itself for glow
interaction: hoisting the driving weight by hand at a two-hand winding crank while the governor trims flash period, running lamp-cell changeovers on a five-position carousel selector and speaking the fog trumpet through a three-position air cock
tagline: Wind her to the top, keep her at forty-five, and let the trumpet do the talking.
